Previous issue bodies/pins are archived with this migration. Acceptance:
- Document every scoped location and province; classify justified/correction-needed/insufficient-evidence individually.
- Research actual source geographic role, source vintage, completeness, license, semantic tier suitability and traceable citations; ADM number alone cannot justify a tier.
- Review fragmented city territories, province-sized locations, anonymous administrative remainders, disconnected territories, omitted islands, repeated tiers, oversized groups, weak parents and inconsistent neighboring units.
- Cover every scoped area purpose, referencing other packet scopes where only part of an area is owned.
- Give sourced correction recommendations and explicit unresolved gaps; create bounded correction/source-restoration followups. Never close source gaps by structure checks or unsupported exceptions.
- Preserve approved outer scopes and coordinate shared parent/source predecessor edits. No geographic or record changes in initial review.
- Two PR budget applies to this evidence packet; if new work exceeds it split bounded children. Completion of initial review does not certify the regional branch or enable imports.

Preserve baseline sources, original inspections, existing factual claims, the macro envelope and other workers' artifacts. Do not change shared hierarchy, footprints, canonical grid, UI/schema, claims or live releases in this initial packet. Findings must link bounded follow-up correction/restoration issues to the parent, with exact affected units and source evidence; not every finding is a geography edit.

issues.body:
Install three validated hierarchy corrections

## Scope and acceptance guidance

- Install the prepared Monaco/Luxembourg grouping corrections and West Virginia duplicate-province correction through a coherent reviewed geographic release.
- Update every dependent hierarchy/catalog/grid-parent lookup and manifest; preserve all original IDs, predecessor relationships, geometry and historical evidence. Revalidate dependent prepared evidence explicitly rather than silently repinning it.
- Publish and verify matching map, inspector, parent boundaries, complete chains, migration accounting and before/after hashes.

**Why:** the candidates are validated proposals, but the live atlas still uses the previous parent assignments. Partial installation would make its datasets disagree.

**References:** [REFERENCE_HIERARCHY_CORRECTIONS.md](REFERENCE_HIERARCHY_CORRECTIONS.md), `data/reference-hierarchy-corrections/migration-receipt.json.gz`, `scripts/prepare-reference-hierarchy-corrections.py`.
